title: RepoSnapshot Ignore Engine Output
$comment: Flat array of surviving directory nodes after ignore compilation and branch pruning. BFS order preserved, NodeDepth non-decreasing. Position [0] is always the root node. Pruned branches are absent entirely.
description: Output of New-IgnoreCompiler (IgnoreEngine.Invoke()). Each surviving node carries compiled regex state for the filter stage. Two mutually exclusive pathways: (1) ExecutiveOverride active — all nodes have ExecutiveOverride regex + null CompiledIgnore, (2) Normal pipeline — all nodes have CompiledIgnore + null ExecutiveOverride. Downstream join with the original crawler graph recovers Files for surviving nodes.

CompiledIgnoreState.title: CompiledIgnoreState
CompiledIgnoreState.description: Compiled regex pair for a node's merged ignore rules. Positives is the main ignore regex (match = ignore). Exceptions is the negation override regex (match = un-ignore). Either may be null if no patterns of that polarity exist at this node after reduction.

Positives.description: Compiled regex for positive ignore patterns, or null if no patterns apply to this node.

Exceptions.description: Compiled regex for negation (!) patterns, or null if no exceptions apply to this node.

OutputNode.title: OutputNode
OutputNode.description: A non-root surviving directory node with compiled ignore state.

NodePath.description: Path relative to snapshot root, forward-slash, trailing '/' required. Same value as the input node.

AbsolutePath.description: Absolute path to this directory, forward-slash normalized, trailing '/' required. Passed through from input.

NodeDepth.description: Depth below snapshot root. Non-root nodes are always >= 1.

CompiledIgnore.description: Compiled ignore state for normal pipeline, or null when ExecutiveOverride pathway is active.

ExecutiveOverride.description: Compiled regex for executive override bypass (match = KEEP, inverted semantics), or null when normal pipeline is active.

RootOutputNode.title: RootOutputNode
RootOutputNode.description: The root node in the output. Always survives pruning. NodePath is always '' (empty string), NodeDepth is always 0.

NodePath.description: Always empty string for the root node.

AbsolutePath.description: Absolute path to the snapshot root, forward-slash normalized, trailing '/' required.

CompiledIgnore.description: Compiled ignore state for normal pipeline, or null when ExecutiveOverride pathway is active.

ExecutiveOverride.description: Compiled regex for executive override bypass, or null when normal pipeline is active.
